title: Values at the filler coordinates
statement: Let $a$ and $K$ be natural numbers with $a\le K$ and $a+3\le K$, and let $u$ be a sign assignment on $a$ coordinates. Extending it to $K$ coordinates by filling new coordinates with $-1$ gives value $-1$ at each of the three coordinates $a,a+1,a+2$.
hypotheses_covered: $u$ is a sign assignment on $a$ coordinates
